items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Uh, you know, Hero and a Mac. Yeah. Well, um, yeah, he was here. He was here from the very beginning.

ctx.x: But he sent Sylvia to make sure Mrs. Willis has three of his instructions properly. And he was...

In a couple weeks that, uh, you know, Larry was away. Well, not... The Society was founded, and, you know... Oh, he was on that one, he was away. Yeah, well, he went to get married. Yeah. And...
